title: Reintentar atestación pública de hardening Tele con HTTP/DNS real
mission: Repeat the served-network attestation only in a runtime with working public DNS/HTTP origin fetch. Fetch the exact GitHub Pages TV room client and remote shell with cache-busting, record response status and SHA-256 of served bytes, and verify the static capability-secret hardening invariants without claiming interactive behavior.
definition_of_done: Fetch both exact public GitHub Pages targets with cache-busting through unrestricted public HTTP/DNS.
Record HTTP status and SHA-256 for each served response.
Verify the served TV client uses sessionStorage for STORE and does not use localStorage for STORE.
Verify the served remote parses room/token from the fragment and scrubs the fragment with history.replaceState.
Do not substitute repository bytes and do not infer interactive, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
